name: Fivetran
tagline: Fivetran is an automated data movement platform that syncs data from 500+ sources — SaaS apps, databases, files — into data warehouses like Snowflake and BigQuery. Its AI features include smart schema migration, anomaly detection in data pipelines, and AI-generated connector mapping.
